RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsEnabledHint: Globally toggle the accessibility module on your client.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsProfileHint: Select a preset profile for contrast and filtering.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsDarkMatteHint: Replaces glare and bright white backgrounds with deep dark matte tones and WCAG AAA contrast.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsAmberModeHint: Applies a warm amber tone over the canvas to reduce eye strain.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsAmberIntensityH: Adjust amber filter intensity on the map (0% - 100%).
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsCanvasBrightnes: Adjust scene brightness level without reloading the map.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsCanvasContrastH: Enhance visual definition of map elements.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsCanvasSaturatio: Reduce or increase color saturation on the map.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsAutoCenterHint: Automatically center popOut windows when opened to assist tunnel vision.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsFocusHighlightH: Highlights active window with a bright border visible in reduced peripheral vision.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsSmartImageInver: Automatically detects and inverts scanned white pages while keeping portraits and art intact.
RP_ACCESSIBILITY.SettingsSmartBackground: Processes and inverts page background images via transparent canvas (experimental).
